profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer at Rentable
profile.summary:
I am an extroverted individual that enjoys challenging work and learning new things. I love leveraging technology and creative thinking to tackle difficult problems and I strive to make a positive impact both inside and outside of work.

My current interests include software, growth/marketing analytics, financial markets, and emerging technologies. Outside of work I like to stay active and spend time outside!

positions.title: Project Associate
positions.description:
Project Associate, Bright Beginnings
• Responsible for managing Cameroonian contacts and the creation of a supply chain for solar lantern distribution in Ndu, Cameroon
• Created and maintained NGO partnerships with local humanitarian service organizations
• Drafted and developed lesson plans for an entrepreneurship curriculum that will be taught to locals in Ndu

Project Associate, Financial Foundations
• Provided management and performance improvement consulting to a water committee in Adu Achi, Nigeria through a partnership with Engineers Without Borders
• Created a cost-volume profit analysis to assess potential investment opportunities for a water purification system
• Sourced and scoped a sustainable farming project to foster job growth, money management and empowerment for unemployed women in Bolivia

positions.title: Accounting Intern in the Office of Research and Analysis
positions.description:
•	Conducted analyses of financial and non-financial information acquired from external sources and PCAOB oversight activities
•	Showcased problem solving and risk analysis skills through challenging ad-hoc and special projects for the Office of Research and Analysis, Division of Registration and Inspections, Division of Enforcement and Investigations, and the Business Intelligence Department involving Microsoft Excel, Audit Analytics, Calcbench, and some S&P Capital IQ
